// Test inputs/oracles: Copyright Grafana Labs contributors; adjacent LICENSE applies.
// Standard-library-only extraction, never execution of Loki/Pulse or AST constructors.
// Usage: producer /path/to/pinned/loki > syntax-admission.json
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

const revision = "5aa4b9212d64d723f63b2770452054aa23df114d"

type object map[string]any
type source struct {
	path string
	data []byte
	fs   *token.FileSet
	file *ast.File
}

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func hash(data []byte) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(data)) }
func load(root, path, want string) *source {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, path))
	must(err)
	if hash(data) != want {
		panic("source differs from pinned revision: " + path)
	}
	fs := token.NewFileSet()
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(fs, path, data, parser.ParseComments)
	must(err)
	return &source{path, data, fs, f}
}
func (s *source) code(n ast.Node) string {
	return string(s.data[s.fs.Position(n.Pos()).Offset:s.fs.Position(n.End()).Offset])
}
func (s *source) span(n ast.Node) object {
	a, b := s.fs.Position(n.Pos()), s.fs.Position(n.End())
	return object{"start_line": a.Line, "start_column": a.Column, "end_line": b.Line,
		"end_column": b.Column, "start_byte": a.Offset, "end_byte_exclusive": b.Offset}
}
func (s *source) record(n ast.Node) object {
	return object{"source": s.path, "source_range": s.span(n), "original_go": s.code(n)}
}
func (s *source) selection(name string, n ast.Node) object {
	r := s.record(n)
	text := s.code(n) + "\n"
	r["name"], r["original_go"], r["sha256"] = name, text, hash([]byte(text))
	return r
}
func (s *source) namedValue(name string) (*ast.GenDecl, *ast.ValueSpec) {
	for _, d := range s.file.Decls {
		if g, ok := d.(*ast.GenDecl); ok {
			for _, spec := range g.Specs {
				if v, ok := spec.(*ast.ValueSpec); ok && len(v.Names) == 1 && v.Names[0].Name == name {
					return g, v
				}
			}
		}
	}
	panic("missing declaration: " + name)
}
func (s *source) function(name string) *ast.FuncDecl {
	for _, d := range s.file.Decls {
		if f, ok := d.(*ast.FuncDecl); ok && f.Name.Name == name {
			return f
		}
	}
	panic("missing function: " + name)
}
func literalString(e ast.Expr) (string, bool) {
	lit, ok := e.(*ast.BasicLit)
	if !ok || lit.Kind != token.STRING {
		return "", false
	}
	v, err := strconv.Unquote(lit.Value)
	must(err)
	return v, true
}
func literalInt(e ast.Expr) (int64, bool) {
	lit, ok := e.(*ast.BasicLit)
	if !ok || lit.Kind != token.INT {
		return 0, false
	}
	v, err := strconv.ParseInt(lit.Value, 0, 64)
	return v, err == nil
}
func nilExpr(e ast.Expr) bool {
	id, ok := e.(*ast.Ident)
	return ok && id.Name == "nil"
}

// Preserve all expressions verbatim. Resolve only the actual original
// NewParseError(string-literal-or-pinned-constant, integer-literal, integer-literal)
// grammar. Unknown forms retain their raw expression, never a guessed diagnostic.
func errorWant(s *source, e ast.Expr, constants map[string]string) object {
	r := s.record(e)
	r["resolved"] = false
	call, ok := e.(*ast.CallExpr)
	if !ok {
		return r
	}
	r["constructor_expression"] = s.code(call.Fun)
	args := []object{}
	for _, arg := range call.Args {
		args = append(args, s.record(arg))
	}
	r["arguments"] = args
	if s.code(call.Fun) != "logqlmodel.NewParseError" || len(call.Args) != 3 {
		return r
	}
	msg, msgOK := literalString(call.Args[0])
	if id, ok := call.Args[0].(*ast.Ident); ok {
		msg, msgOK = constants[id.Name]
	}
	line, lineOK := literalInt(call.Args[1])
	col, colOK := literalInt(call.Args[2])
	if msgOK && lineOK && colOK {
		r["resolved"] = true
		r["diagnostic"] = object{"message": msg, "line": line, "column": col}
	}
	return r
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		panic("usage: producer /path/to/pinned/loki")
	}
	s := load(os.Args[1], "pkg/logql/syntax/parser_test.go", "0a8466fd5d9cab3f852f9a18a52dc54b7b1a1ab0c9c6af53ca1df21d9f38ce99")
	p := load(os.Args[1], "pkg/logql/syntax/parser.go", "a38e8d4760af3969d5316e456db8abed93655a66fd81f8cfdd2fa50226142667")
	e := load(os.Args[1], "pkg/logqlmodel/error.go", "21816c4294243f16157f6408d92fb0907612a3258333288ab39b3f84bf7a4db5")
	g, v := s.namedValue("ParseTestCases")
	if len(v.Values) != 1 {
		panic("unexpected table values")
	}
	table := v.Values[0].(*ast.CompositeLit)
	fn := s.function("TestParse")
	_, constant := p.namedValue("errAtleastOneEqualityMatcherRequired")
	msg, ok := literalString(constant.Values[0])
	if !ok {
		panic("constant is not an original string literal")
	}
	resolvedConstant := p.record(constant)
	resolvedConstant["name"], resolvedConstant["value"] = constant.Names[0].Name, msg
	constants := map[string]string{constant.Names[0].Name: msg}
	assertions := []object{}
	ast.Inspect(fn.Body, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		if c, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
			switch s.code(c.Fun) {
			case "require.Equal", "AssertExpressions":
				assertions = append(assertions, s.record(c))
			}
		}
		return true
	})
	if len(assertions) != 2 || assertions[0]["original_go"] != "require.Equal(t, tc.err, err)" || assertions[1]["original_go"] != "AssertExpressions(t, tc.exp, ast)" {
		panic("unexpected original assertion calls")
	}
	rows := []object{}
	accepted, rejected, invalidUTF8 := 0, 0, 0
	queries := map[string]int{}
	for i, elt := range table.Elts {
		entry := elt.(*ast.CompositeLit)
		fields := map[string]ast.Expr{}
		for _, item := range entry.Elts {
			kv := item.(*ast.KeyValueExpr)
			name := kv.Key.(*ast.Ident).Name
			if name != "in" && name != "exp" && name != "err" {
				panic("unexpected row field: " + name)
			}
			if fields[name] != nil {
				panic("duplicate field")
			}
			fields[name] = kv.Value
		}
		query, ok := literalString(fields["in"])
		if !ok {
			panic("query is not an original string literal")
		}
		r := s.record(entry)
		r["source_index"] = i // zero-based, never deduplicate source rows
		r["query_expression"] = s.code(fields["in"])
		r["query_bytes_base64"] = base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(query))
		r["query_utf8_valid"] = utf8.ValidString(query)
		if utf8.ValidString(query) {
			r["query"] = query
		} else {
			// JSON strings cannot carry invalid UTF-8; never replace original bytes.
			r["query"] = nil
			invalidUTF8++
		}
		queries[query]++
		r["expected_ast_expression"], r["expected_error_expression"] = nil, nil
		r["expected_ast_present"] = fields["exp"] != nil
		r["expected_error_present"] = fields["err"] != nil
		if exp := fields["exp"]; exp != nil {
			r["expected_ast_expression"] = s.code(exp)
		}
		reject := fields["err"] != nil && !nilExpr(fields["err"])
		r["reject"] = reject
		if err := fields["err"]; err != nil {
			r["expected_error_expression"] = s.code(err)
			r["expected_error"] = errorWant(s, err, constants)
		}
		if reject {
			rejected++
		} else {
			accepted++
		}
		rows = append(rows, r)
	}
	// Independent fixed source-count controls, in addition to complete-file hashes.
	if len(table.Elts) != 206 || len(rows) != 206 || accepted != 159 || rejected != 47 || len(queries) != 205 || invalidUTF8 != 1 {
		panic("pinned source counts differ")
	}
	if hash([]byte(s.code(g)+"\n")) != "476eab68004f9a52beaf52e0820ec099d497bd781ca230e5cd06d114b39f2757" ||
		hash([]byte(s.code(fn)+"\n")) != "91dd9d3f5f254bb2b9f7491227084b615413739413081ba3a59c69162ac63dfb" {
		panic("pinned complete declaration/executor selection differs")
	}
	support := []object{e.selection("NewParseError", e.function("NewParseError")), e.selection("ParseError.Error", e.function("Error"))}
	for _, d := range e.file.Decls {
		if g, ok := d.(*ast.GenDecl); ok {
			for _, spec := range g.Specs {
				if t, ok := spec.(*ast.TypeSpec); ok && t.Name.Name == "ParseError" {
					support = append(support, e.selection("ParseError", g))
				}
			}
		}
	}
	sources := []object{}
	for _, src := range []*source{s, p, e} {
		sources = append(sources, object{"path": src.path, "sha256": hash(src.data)})
	}
	out := object{"schema_version": 1, "revision": revision, "sources": sources,
		"selections":      []object{s.selection("ParseTestCases", g), s.selection("TestParse", fn)},
		"assertion_calls": assertions, "resolved_constants": []object{resolvedConstant},
		"supporting_declarations": support, "row_count": len(rows), "accepted_count": accepted,
		"rejected_count": rejected, "unique_query_count": len(queries),
		"duplicate_query_row_count": len(rows) - len(queries), "invalid_utf8_query_count": invalidUTF8, "rows": rows}
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
	must(encoder.Encode(out))
}
